thread:
Elena (Sales): Heads up — Contoso POC is ready to sign the orderform but Procurement wants MSA + DPA redlines and a KMS exception. Can legal advise on required language? Also pricing ask: they prefer a monthly commit vs pure usage. @Marta (Legal) @Priya (Finance)
Marta (Legal): Need the counterparty redline PDF to start. Do we know if they require customer-managed CMKs or just attestations? Any specific vendor KMS names?
Elena (Sales): They specified AWS KMS and want customer-controlled CMKs for keys. Attached in thread: contoso_redlines.pdf and SysSec-2026 questionnaire.
Priya (Finance): Pricing note — Contoso is asking for 10% off for a 12mo commit + net60. Our standard is net30 and up to 5% for that commit level. Do we have flexibility?
Sam (Eng): POC traffic estimate needed. If they truly need customer-managed keys on Hosted, that's a platform constraint. We normally permit CMKs only on Private or Dedicated.
Elena (Sales): For the POC they expect ~1k reqs/day with spikes. They want to start hosted but may request Dedicated later.
Marta (Legal): Draft position: "Customer-managed keys permitted only on Private or Dedicated deployments; Hosted deployments use Redwood-managed keys unless an approved exception is granted." I'll draft an exception clause for this POC if procurement insists, but need approval from Security.
Priya (Finance): Compromise proposal: net45 + 7% discount for 12mo commit if legal approves the KMS exception. Is that acceptable from product/ops?
Sam (Eng): Dedicated fallback (2 x A100 equiv) for sustained POC load would be advisable for 99.95 SLA requests. If they stay Hosted, we can do best-effort but no CMK support.
Elena (Sales): Procurement also requested DocuSign routing: PO signer first, then Contoso legal, then Redwood sales ops, then Redwood legal. Who is the PO signer on our side? @CarlosOps?
CarlosOps: I can sign the PO. Net45 is workable pending finance sign-off. For DocuSign: I need the final orderform PDF + the redline bundle attached. Also confirm signer emails.
Marta (Legal): I'll be the Redwood legal signer. Quick flag: if their redlines include indemnity or broad data transfer language we will push back. I'll note exceptions inline.
Elena (Sales): Noted. Next steps proposal: 1) Marta drafts KMS exception language & flags any risky redlines; 2) Sam confirms Dedicated cost delta and whether 99.95 SLA feasible; 3) Priya runs pricing approval for net45/7%; 4) I prepare DocuSign envelope with attachments and signer order. ETA tomorrow EOD?
Marta (Legal): On it. If Security requires additional controls for CMKs, I'll surface requirements here.
Sam (Eng): I'll produce a minimal Dedicated estimate + ops notes by EOD. Also note: 99.95 SLA needs reserved capacity and priority routing — expect ~20% uplift.
Priya (Finance): I'll confirm the 7% approval window with RevOps and post update by EOD.
Elena (Sales): Quick question from procurement — can we allow Customer KMS for Hosted if they accept additional audit & SOC2 scope?
Marta (Legal): Practically no. Hosted multi-tenant with customer CMKs is operationally risky. We can allow on Dedicated/Private with attestation and audit. I'll write that in the response.
ops-bot: SLA-pricing.csv uploaded to the shared sales drive: https://files.redwood.com/SLA-pricing.csv :rotating_light:
CarlosOps: Documenting signer order and that there is no exec signature required for POC. Elena, pls confirm you'll include the SysSec-2026 answers in the envelope and call out any DPA redline acceptance conditions.
Elena (Sales): Yep — I'll attach SysSec-2026 answers and contoso_redlines.pdf and include a cover note: "MSA redlines accepted subject to final legal approval; pricing and SLA contingent on Dedicated confirmation if 99.95 requested."
Marta (Legal): Add this tag inside DocuSign: "Legal: provisional acceptance — final sign-off after SecOps check." Also please route a copy to legal@redwood.com for records.
Sam (Eng): One more ops note: if they move to Dedicated mid-POC we'll need a 48-72h lead time for provisioning.
Priya (Finance): Noted. If Legal approves KMS exception and we go net45/7%, I can approve the PO signoff.
Elena (Sales): Great — I'll prepare envelope tonight and ping everyone. Thanks team :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 48h to confirm redline resolution and DocuSign completion.
